            "../gpui_linux/src/linux/x11/window.rs",
            "../gpui_windows/src/window.rs"

          "topic": "走读 PlatformWindow trait（含 raw-window-handle 的 HasWindowHandle/HasDisplayHandle 约束），覆盖标题、大小、位置、缩放、焦点、全屏、窗口控制区与注意力请求（request_attention 在 X11 上通过 set_wm_hints_urgency 设置 WM_HINTS urgency 标志、窗口转为激活时自动清除）等方法，并以 Linux 侧实现为例。自 f4178619ac 起 X11 的 activate() 只发送 _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW ClientMessage、不再附加 SetInputFocus(POINTER_ROOT) 强制抢焦点，焦点裁决完全交给窗口管理器。自 eb354c8d50 起，原 completed_frame 方法更名为 schedule_frame，语义从「帧完成后通知平台」变为「请求平台调度下一帧」：GPUI 在窗口有脏区、待呈现帧或 next_frame_callbacks 非空时调用它唤醒已停泊的渲染循环，默认空实现，目前仅 Wayland 与测试 TestWindow 覆写；讲义已按该版源码完成修订。"

    `BenchReport`'s frame histograms only ever recorded a window's draw and
    present timings, so a slow foreground task that never dirtied or drew a
    window was invisible to `gpui::bench` consumers even though GPUI's
    foreground journal already timed it. Delta hit this concretely: a
    foreground task stalled for 76-130ms with no window draw in progress,
    and the only way to see it in a benchmark was to manually queue a marker
    task and time it by hand, outside the normal report.
    
    GPUI already has the data needed to close this gap. The foreground
    journal (`crate::profiler::journal`, merged separately in #62779) times
    every foreground task poll, action handler, and input dispatch on the
    main thread, independent of whether a window ever gets involved. This PR
    wires that journal into `BenchAppContext`/`BenchReport` so the existing
    benchmark harness reports it directly, instead of asking benchmark
    authors to build their own timing side channel.
    
    `TraceScope`, the type that already scopes frame-timing collection to a
    measurement, now also owns a `ForegroundJournalCollector` created at the
    same point it starts. Since a collector only observes journal entries
    recorded after its own creation, per-iteration setup work (which runs
    before the trace scope starts) is excluded from the measurement by
    construction, the same way it already was for draw/present timings.
    Drained task poll, action, and input events are recorded into a new
    `foreground_work` duration histogram on `BenchReport` (draws and
    presents are skipped there since the existing frame-timing histograms
    already cover them), exposed through `BenchReport::foreground_work()` as
    `count`/`total`/`max`/percentiles plus frame-budget overruns at the
    report's configured FPS, and printed alongside the existing histograms.
    
    Because this rides on the same per-task-poll instrumentation that
    already powers GPUI's hang detection, it works for `bench_task`,
    `bench_batched_task`, and `bench_renderer` without requiring a window at
    all, and it aggregates every foreground event recorded during a
    measurement (not just the first).
    
    The `#[cfg(test)]`-only `install_test_foreground_journal` helper is
    widened from `pub(super)` to `pub(crate)` so `bench_context`'s own tests
    can install an isolated per-thread journal instead of sharing (and being
    interfered by) whatever the shared production journal on that thread
    happens to hold.
    
    ## Testing
    
    - `cargo test -p gpui --features bench --lib bench_context` - two new
    focused unit tests drive the foreground journal directly: one proves a
    60ms synchronous task poll with no window is reported as foreground work
    with no frame events recorded; the other proves an 80ms task poll before
    the trace scope starts is excluded from the measured summary. A third
    test exercises the real public API end to end, running
    `BenchAppContext::bench_task` through an actual `criterion::Bencher`
    (via `criterion::Criterion::bench_function`) and asserting the ~20ms
    task shows up in `BenchReport::foreground_work()`.
    - `cargo nextest run -p gpui --features bench --lib profiler` - the
    existing foreground journal, hang detection, and frame-timing test
    suites still pass unchanged.
    - `cargo check -p benchmarks --benches` - the existing `#[gpui::bench]`
    consumers (`bench_iter`, `bench_renderer`) still compile against the
    updated `TraceScope`/`BenchReport` internals.
    - `cargo fmt --package gpui -- --check` and `./script/clippy -p gpui
    --features bench` are clean.
    
    Release Notes:
    
    - N/A

data.rationale: 本轮增量区间（f36aec822b → fd82517a11）仅 2 个提交：fd82517a11（Tangled git 托管支持）只改动 crates/git、git_hosting_providers、settings_content 与 docs，与本手册无关；7316cf7745（gpui: Report foreground executor work in bench reports）是唯一触及手册覆盖范围的提交，经 git diff --name-only 核对，六个相关 crate 中只有两个文件变化：crates/gpui/src/app/bench_context.rs（+323 行，TraceScope 现在同时持有 ForegroundJournalCollector、finish 返回 TracedEvents、BenchReport 新增 foreground_work 直方图与 ForegroundWorkSummary/DurationHistogram、报告打印新增前台工作段）与 crates/gpui/src/profiler/journal.rs（11 行，install_test_foreground_journal 与 TestForegroundJournalGuard 从 pub(super) 放宽为 pub(crate) 并补文档，均为 cfg(test) 代码）。全手册 34 篇中唯一引用 journal.rs 的是 u4-l6（前台工作日志与 hang 检测），该讲义大量按行号引用 journal.rs（如 876-906、533-535 等，本次改动使 556 行之后整体下移约 5 行），且其主题本就是「前台日志的消费者」，因此标为 update：刷新行号并把 bench 接入作为新的消费者补入（bench_iter/bench_task/bench_renderer 三个入口都会把无窗口的任务轮询、动作与输入分发汇入 BenchReport::foreground_work），同时在 source_files 中新增 ../gpui/src/app/bench_context.rs、在学习目标与实践任务中加入对应条目；hang 检测、IntervalSealer、ForegroundRunnableCounter 等核心内容未变，无需重建。核对讲义目录确认：上一轮标记 new 的 u8-l1、u8-l2、u8-l3（文本系统、图集渲染、无头渲染）已由 worker 按当前源码生成完毕，连同此前已就绪的 u1 至 u7 共 29 篇，本区间内其引用源码零变化，统一标 keep；仅剩 u8-l4（test-support）与 u8-l5（自定义 Platform 毕业实践）尚未生成，维持 new，其引用的 platform/test 系列文件与 schedule_frame/TestWindow 模拟设施在本区间未变，worker 可直接按规划撰写。八单元、34 篇的结构、依赖关系与讲义顺序保持不变。

lectures.practice_task: 以 gpui 的 profiler feature 构建一个小窗口程序，在按钮回调里通过 cx.foreground_journal() 拿到 journal 与 collector，collect_unseen 后打印最近几条 ForegroundJournalEntry；再人为插入一段忙循环，用极小的 threshold 与 frame_budget 构造 HangDetector，验证 poll 能产出 HangIncident，并记录触发的是哪条判定标准。可选延伸：改用 --features bench 写一个 #[gpui::bench] 的 bench_task，在无窗口的工作负载下读取 BenchReport::foreground_work()（或报告打印中的 foreground executor work 段），验证不产生任何绘制的前台任务也会被计时上报。
lectures.title: 前台工作日志与 hang 检测：profiler 对调度链路的插桩
lectures.topic: 讲解 gpui 的 profiler feature（依赖 hdrhistogram）的前台工作日志机制：ForegroundExecutor 与 PlatformScheduler 如何通过 ForegroundRunnableCounter 记录排队任务、window.rs 如何记录每帧从 dirty 到 present 的轨迹、journal.rs 的事件流与 FrameSnapshot 模型，以及 hang.rs 的 HangDetector 如何从日志流中事后检测主线程卡顿并产出 HangIncident。本次更新补入 7316cf7745（Report foreground executor work in bench reports）：TraceScope 现在在测量起点同时创建 ForegroundJournalCollector（collector 只观测创建之后的条目，因此每轮迭代的 setup 天然被排除在测量外）、finish 返回 TracedEvents（frame_events 与 journal_entries），BenchAppContext 的 bench_iter/bench_task/bench_renderer 都会把采集到的前台事件经 record_foreground_events 写入 BenchReport 新增的 foreground_work 直方图（DurationHistogram 以精确 total_nanos 配合桶化直方图；Draw/Present 事件跳过、SmallPolls 取 flush.summary.total），经 BenchReport::foreground_work() 输出 ForegroundWorkSummary（count/total/max/p50/p90/p95/p99 与按报告 FPS 的帧预算超支计数），报告打印时单独成段且无需窗口参与；bench_renderer 中帧计时仍按 window_id 过滤而前台工作不按窗口过滤。journal.rs 侧仅有的变化是 cfg(test) 助手 install_test_foreground_journal 与 TestForegroundJournalGuard 由 pub(super) 放宽为 pub(crate) 并补了文档（供 bench_context 测试安装隔离的每线程 journal），数据模型与 hang 检测未变；讲义中引用的 journal.rs 行号需按当前源码刷新（556 行之后整体下移约 5 行）。
